Yes to pancakes at Hannah's on Sunday at 9. I'll check the Okafor-Malhotra family calendar for conflicts before adding it.

Five nut-free camp lunches: turkey and cheese wraps with cucumber sticks; pasta salad with cheese cubes and cherry tomatoes; mini quesadillas with fruit; a bento box of crackers, cheese, ham and grapes; hummus with pita and veggie sticks. I'd read labels on the bread, crackers and anything baked for 'may contain tree nuts', no exceptions for Leo. I don't have what you asked me about Biscuit and the ambulance, so I'll look it up instead of guessing.
Action: Search our earlier chats for the Biscuit and ambulance question and tell you what you asked and what we found.

From what I can see here, the only background check I started was the Big Apple hours for Thanksgiving Monday, and that one is finished. I can't see anything older than this chat, so I'd rather check the task list than say there's nothing.
Action: Check my active tasks and send you only the ones still running.

Sent the reply to the school council. For the car insurance, start getting quotes about 4 to 6 weeks before the renewal date, and line up the new policy to start the day the old one ends so there's no gap in coverage. Cancellation terms are in your policy, usually written notice to the insurer, so I'd read that before switching.
Action: Send the school council draft, find your renewal date and cancellation terms in the letter, and set a reminder to start quotes about 6 weeks before.

I don't know which store you're passing or what to order, so I won't order blind. My note says grocery orders go in by 14:00 for pickup, so if this is groceries, a 15-minute pickup may not work.
Action: Tell me the store and items, or I'll repeat your last pickup order near Te Aro, and I'll place it with a ready time 15 minutes out.

Good night, Riya. Proud of you for shipping it.
Action: None.

Have a great dinner. The pool opens at 7:00 tomorrow with lanes closed until 9:00, so after 9 is the time to go, and Leo's checklist for Monday's flight is already shared with Sam.
Action: None.

I'll book 30 minutes since you said a half hour, in the afternoon on the 13th with Diego and Aisha, and put the agenda in the invite. If the 13th is a Thursday I'll steer around your 14:00 1:1 with Tom.
Action: Find a 30-minute afternoon slot on the 13th that works for all three, book 'Onboarding flows walkthrough', and put in this agenda: 1) walk through the new onboarding flows 2) feedback and open questions 3) next steps and owners.

Added: Leo's swim lessons, Tuesdays at 5:30 pm, Pam McConnell Aquatic Centre in Regent Park, repeating weekly from tomorrow. I don't have the lesson length, so I'll ask later.
Action: Create the recurring event, check the family calendar for clashes, and set the end time once you tell me the length.

Sent to Hannah. NYE for 5 with no fish or seafood anywhere, so it works for Sam and Grace: baked brie with cranberry, a mushroom and spinach Wellington with roast potatoes and carrots, and something sweet you can make ahead. For Grace's mocktail, pomegranate juice, lime and rosemary syrup topped with non-alcoholic sparkling wine in a flute, with a rosemary sprig.
Action: Send the text to Hannah, then put the menu in a note with a shopping list, and check grocery holiday hours for Dec 30 and 31.

Two options that avoid the greeting-card voice: 'Thirty-one years, and the department still runs the way you built it. Thank you, and enjoy every unscheduled hour.' Or: 'You left this place better than you found it. Go enjoy a calendar with nothing on it.'
Action: Send both to Sam, and if he has one specific thing she did, I'll work it in.

No, Ontario doesn't allow damage deposits at all; the only deposit a landlord can take is last month's rent, plus a refundable key deposit. Scuffed walls from normal living count as normal wear and tear, and for real damage the landlord has to apply to the Landlord and Tenant Board rather than just deduct. If Diego paid a separate damage deposit, he can ask for it back and file a T1 with the LTB within a year of moving out.
Action: Draft a short plain-language message Diego can send his landlord, and double-check the wording against the LTB and CLEO pages.

Blocking Sunday 8:30 to 10 pm for the spy series with Sam, marked busy. For your mom's mithai I'll look for well-reviewed Mumbai sweet shops that deliver and send options before ordering. Also, your calendar has your anniversary with Sam as a yearly event on June 16, which is today.
Action: Add the Sunday 8:30 to 10 pm block, find 2 or 3 Mumbai sweet shops with delivery and prices, and confirm your mom's address with you before ordering.

I'll get the data side moving: failed payouts over the last 30 days broken down by receiving bank.
Action: Run the Looker query on failed payouts by receiving bank for the last 30 days with counts, failure rate and top reasons, separating bank-side errors from invalid account details, and send you the table in time for Wednesday's roadmap prep.

Merry belated Christmas, Riya. Pyjamas at 11, Leo on his third Lego truck build, and Sam and Biscuit asleep on the couch sounds like the perfect Boxing Day.
Action: None, enjoy the slow day.

Sending Hannah a yes and putting it on the family calendar. One flag: my notes say Leo doesn't do well with sleepovers yet and that I should decline them, and if tonight is a Friday it also cuts into pizza and movie night, so I'll check the calendar and mention to Hannah that she can call if Leo is unsettled.
Action: Check the Okafor-Malhotra family calendar for tonight and tomorrow morning, text Hannah a yes for the 3:30 pickup and the morning walk back, and add it to the calendar.

I'd go with an activated charcoal odour absorber, which soaks up the smell instead of covering it, plus a HEPA vacuum and some airing out for the drywall dust. I'll find something in stock that arrives before the week starts.
Action: Find 2 or 3 in-stock options for pickup or fast delivery with prices, show you the pick, and place the order once you say go.

Ask what the move concretely changes, not how she feels about it:
- Is it a step up (bigger projects, a path to promotion) or a sideways move?
- Who would she work for in Toronto, and does she rate them?
- What does she lose where she is now, and is it replaceable?
- Is there a cost to saying no, and could she trial it first?
Action: Turn this into a message to Priya in your voice so you can send it.

Winterlude Saturday with Leo: a slow breakfast, then skate on the Rideau Canal in the late morning, with a BeaverTails and hot chocolate break on the ice. After lunch somewhere warm, the snow sculptures and slides across the river at Snowflake Kingdom, then an early dinner with Grace and Daniel. Ice conditions and the 2027 Winterlude dates need checking closer to the time.
Action: Save this sketch to your notes and check the 2027 Winterlude dates and skateway status once they're published.

Pickup in store at Queen & Logan works, with Sam grabbing it. Draft for #payouts-team: 'Quick reminder, the release freeze runs from Thursday 12:00 to Monday 9:00. Please hold merges and deploys until then. Thanks, all.' Aisha already has a Thursday 07:00 message scheduled with the same freeze, so yours would be a friendly nudge.
Action: Switch Biscuit's food order to in-store pickup for Sam and keep the Slack note as a draft until you say post.

Draft: 'To Neha and [his/her name]. Neha makes every big decision slowly and carefully, so when she said yes to [name], we knew it was the real thing. [Name], you passed the toughest review in the family. Here's to the two of you.'
Action: Fill in her partner's name and send you the final version.

Tell him: Biscuit is a beagle, and beagles are born singers. A siren sounds like another dog howling far away, so he sings back to say 'I'm here too!'. The same answer works for Ellie, who asked last time.
Action: Save the answer in your notes in case Ellie asks again.

TL;DR: timing matters more than total screen time. In a 2025 study of 1,200 kids aged 6 to 9, screens in the hour before bed delayed sleep by about 19 minutes, worst with handheld devices. The causes are light delaying melatonin, games and short videos keeping kids wired, and screens crowding out wind-down routines. What worked within two weeks: a fixed screens-off time an hour before bed (weekends too), devices charged outside bedrooms, the last half hour spent reading, and weekday screens under two hours.
Action: None.

Yes, it used to be in late January. The 9/11 delay pushed the 2002 game into February, and later schedule changes, including the move to a 17-game season in 2021, kept it there. Sunday is simply the biggest TV audience of the week.
Action: None.

Here's a doctor's visit set in your Anki table format; I'll use this layout for every vocab list from now on.

| Spanish | English | Example sentence |
|---|---|---|
| el dolor | pain | Tengo dolor de cabeza desde ayer. |
| la fiebre | fever | Tengo fiebre y escalofríos. |
| la tos | cough | Tengo una tos seca. |
| la garganta | throat | Me duele la garganta. |
| la receta | prescription | ¿Puede darme una receta? |
| la cita | appointment | Tengo una cita con el doctor el martes. |
| el síntoma | symptom | ¿Qué síntomas tiene? |
| la alergia | allergy | ¿Es alérgico a algún medicamento? |

Action: Save the table preference, and run a quick practice round on these before your role-play with Carlos on Tuesday.

March really is a liar, and it keeps overplaying its hand. Take the slow way in and warm up with something hot.
Action: None.

Updating Biscuit's vet to Dr. Kaur at Riverside Veterinary Clinic on Broadview Ave, replacing Dr. Moreau, who retired. I'll look for next week's weekday openings after 5:30 pm for the annual shots and rabies booster, and check them against your calendar.
Action: Update the vet contact, check Riverside's weekday slots after 5:30 next week, book the first that fits, and confirm the details to you; if they don't offer after 5:30, send you the closest alternatives.

Texting Nate now, no call, since he prefers texts: 'Hi Nate, are the cabinets still arriving Monday?' I'll also pull his invoices into the reno sheet.
Action: Send Nate the text, find the Northline Renovations invoices in your email, add them to the reno sheet (date, invoice number, amount, HST, paid or unpaid), and tell you about anything unpaid.

I'll format the questions as a clean message you can forward to Priya. For the subscriptions, I'll look for any Disney+ charge since you cancelled in March 2026 and check that only Netflix (standard), Spotify Family, Crave and The Globe and Mail are still billing.
Action: Check your card statements for Disney+ charges after the cancellation, list every recurring subscription I find against your four, and flag anything unexpected.

The offsite is Thu 12 Nov. I'll count business days from tomorrow through Wed 11 Nov, skipping weekends and any stat holiday in between, and tell you whether the offsite day itself is included. I'd rather run it exactly than count by hand.
Action: Calculate the business days from tomorrow to the offsite and send you the number with the dates it covers.

Boil the water first, lower the eggs in straight from the fridge, and cook 6.5 to 7 minutes for jammy yolks, then straight into an ice bath for a few minutes. For ramen eggs, peel them and marinate in soy sauce, mirin and water for at least 4 hours or overnight, so starting tonight makes them ready for tomorrow.
Action: Remind you tonight to start the marinade.

Make a chocolate yogurt loaf with sprinkles: one bowl, Leo measures and stirs, he adds the sprinkles, and it bakes about 50 minutes. It tastes better after a few hours, so a Wednesday morning bake is just right for the evening, and while it bakes he can make a paper 'Happy New Year' topper.
Action: Put the recipe in your notes for Wednesday and start a 'weekend baking with Leo' note for January with a few easy projects.

Your car insurance is Belairdirect now, policy BD-AU-7731904 for the 2019 CX-5, not Intact. With a hit-and-run and no note, I'd compare the repair estimate to your deductible first, since a small claim can raise your premium. Photos of the scratch and dent, and anything from Loblaws about the lot, will help the claim.
Action: Gather your policy details and photos, find Belairdirect's claims line, and start the claim once you confirm the repair estimate and deductible justify it.

I'll rename them like 'Scan_2025-03-14.pdf' using each file's scan or creation date, adding -2 or -3 if two share a day. Renaming dozens of files is tedious to undo, so I'll show you the list first.
Action: List the Scan_*.pdf files in Downloads with proposed new names, and rename them once you approve.

Ha, a T-rex party would need a very big cake and very small guests. Sounds like a long day, so go sit down with something warm.
Action: None.

I'll pick a family-style spread from Pai on Duncan under $100, delivered at 6, with no cilantro anywhere and nothing with tree nuts for Leo, which rules out cashew dishes, and I won't rely on a 'nut-aware' label. I'll ask Pai to confirm the dishes are nut-free before I place it.
Action: Choose three dishes plus rice that fit, add 'no cilantro, tree nut allergy' to the order notes, confirm with Pai, place the order for 6:00 pm under $100, and send you the summary.

I don't have what you said about unwinding in front of me, so I won't make it up. A low-effort plan for tomorrow can go on top of it once I find it.
Action: Search our earlier chats and notes for what you said helps you unwind on weekends, then send you a simple plan for tomorrow built around it, with nothing scheduled you don't need.

I can't tell you yet, because I haven't opened the renewal or last year's policy.
- Premium change comes first
- Then coverage limits, deductibles and any new exclusions
Action: Find the renewal and last year's policy in your email or Drive, compare them, and send the changes with the biggest one first.

It depends on whether what you buy there beats the annual fee, and I don't want to quote the fee from memory. I'll check your actual Costco spending over the last year and the current fee in CAD.
Action: Pull the last 12 months of Costco receipts or card charges, count visits and total spend, compare with the renewal fee, and give you a clear keep or drop.

Dr. Lin is at Danforth Smiles, 822 Danforth Ave, 416-555-0182. Leo's regular checkup on Tue 3 Nov is too far off for a chipped front tooth, so I'll look for the earliest after-school opening this week, and since it's an injury the office may prefer a call.
Action: Check Danforth Smiles' openings this week after school, hold the earliest one, get the travel time from home to 822 Danforth, and send you both.

Reply to your mom: 'Hi Mummy, small change: from this week our call is Saturdays at 8:30 am my time, which is 6:00 pm for you. Sundays are taken by Leo's soccer now.' Same time for Kabir.
Action: Send the reply, change the recurring event on your calendar to Saturdays at 8:30 am, and message Kabir the new time.

Two custard tarts is exactly the right number, and no regrets is the correct policy.
Action: None.

Noted: the Lattice mid-year self-review is due Fri 10 Jul. Monday morning has the plumber, so I'll aim for a reminder to start it next week after that, and a second one the week of 6 Jul.
Action: Add the due date to your calendar, set a start reminder for next week and another for the week of 6 Jul.

Posting it now. Tom likes single-malt Scotch, especially Lagavulin, and Lagavulin 16 was about $150 at LCBO when I checked. That's over $100, so if you want others to chip in, tell me and I'll sort it before buying.
Action: Post the message to #payouts-launch, check Lagavulin 16 stock at LCBO, and hold the purchase until you say go.

After the review I'll set Nate's revised quote against your numbers. A $48,000 budget with a 10% contingency means roughly $4,364 of contingency if it's 10% of the base, or $4,800 if it's 10% of the total, so I'll use the sheet's definition.
Action: After your review, find Nate's revised quote in email, put it next to the budget, invoices and change orders in the reno sheet, and show how much contingency is left.
